sources.title: Rookie TE Dallen Bentley will need to prove himself as a blocker if he wants to make the Broncos 53-man roster
sources.description: With their second of three 7th round selections in the 2026 NFL Draft, the Broncos double-dipped at tight end and selected Utah’s Dallen Bentley. Earlier on Day 3, they drafted NC State’s Justin Joly, and now Bentley will join him as the new additions to the Broncos tight end room. Bentley is a 6-4, 253-pound […]
